info.title: HELIOS API v1 — people, plans, execution, evidence and approved time
info.description: Scoped read, personnel and task preparation/publication slices; legacy execution remains limited to existing legacy fixtures. All protected routes require active tenant membership. Directors see their tenant, master/PTO need active project membership, workers additionally need own active employee assignment for projects/tasks. Own employee profile may be read without assignment. Details hide inaccessible rows with 404. Counts use authorized rows. Overview uses civil day in tenant timezone with half-open timestamp bounds. reviewedReportsForDay means accepted_quantity IS NOT NULL, including zero, not completed tasks. currentOpenShifts is current across days. Null acceptedQuantity means no report in the group has been reviewed. No mixed-unit sum. Unavailable metrics are intentional capability declarations. Phase02a adds director-only people commands with durable requestId replay, expectedVersion, immutable yes/no admission evidence, project assignments and crews. Document references are metadata only. Current admission requires latest attempt/template and exact active qualification id/version, inclusive tenant civil-date expiry. Phase02b adds project catalogs, strict managed drafts, immutable front checks and atomic director publication. Legacy create is retired410; managed tasks reject legacy sync/report mutations409 before replay/effects. 68 v1 operations plus one deprecated legacy creation route (69 total). Server03a adds ordered managed execution events, exact provisional civil-time reads and additive managedExecution overview. Server03b adds six private binary evidence routes and five revisioned exact-time/XLSX routes. Current private storage is local filesystem, with explicit separate FS/PG durability boundaries. Browser durable queue/UI integration/physical-phone acceptance remain03c; authority workflow/quality/material/ID remain04; operations/S3/AV/backups and full pilot acceptance remain pending.
